name: Stone Lobbas
text: Army marker for the Sons of Behemat Stone Lobbas. Its battle traits, regiment abilities and enhancements are listed on the army.

name: Boulder Basher
text: The general has the Hero keyword and does not have Reinforcements, so it can never be called back. It is the only Hero in the army.

name: Bowled Over
text: In your shooting phase, pick an enemy unit that has had at least 1 damage point allocated to it by shooting attacks from friendly units this turn and roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, whenever the enemy makes a charge roll for that unit, change the highest dice in the roll so it equals the lowest dice before adding them up.

name: Close One Eye!
text: In your hero phase, your general picks another friendly unit wholly within 12" of it. Add 1 to hit rolls for that unit's shooting attacks for the rest of the turn.

name: Surly Sorts
text: Once per battle, in any combat phase, pick a friendly unit that is in combat. Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

name: Greedy and Grabby
text: Add 5 to the control score of every friendly unit.

name: Drop, Toss or Roll
text: In your shooting phase, before this unit shoots, pick one option for it until the end of the turn. Drop: its ranged weapons have Shoot in Combat. Toss: add 6" to the Range of its ranged weapons. Roll: add 1 to hit rolls for its shooting attacks. An option picked for one friendly unit cannot be picked for another friendly unit in the same turn.

modes.name: Drop
modes.text: Ranged weapons have Shoot in Combat.

modes.name: Toss
modes.text: Add 6" to the Range of ranged weapons.

modes.name: Roll
modes.text: Add 1 to hit rolls for shooting attacks.

name: 'Ard 'Ead
text: Once per battle, in any combat phase, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made with the general's 'Eadbutt until the end of the turn.

name: Humongous Strides
text: Add 1 to charge rolls for the general.

name: Lucky Rock
text: Once per battle, in your shooting phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the general's Hurlin' Rocks until the end of the turn.

name: Hungry Gobbler
text: At the end of any turn, if the general's combat attacks slew at least one enemy model this turn, Heal (D3) the general.
